title: Trace2World: Reconstructing App Worlds from Real Interaction Traces for Scalable GUI Agent Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.30792v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling GUI reinforcement learning requires environments that preserve real-app behavior. Yet coupling behavior inference with coding can turn partial traces into runnable mocks with incorrect state transitions. We introduce \textbf{Trace2World}, which separates global behavior reconstruction from implementation. It reconciles traces into a shared, source-linked app model, then compiles an executable environment. Independent replay of source workflows localizes mismatches for bounded implementation repair. Validated worlds then support learner-adaptive task and environment augmentation within source-supported behavior. From 1,570 traces, Trace2World constructs 50 environments. On 200 workflows across ten apps, 91.1% are reproduced end to end, versus 59.8% for the strongest matched task-local baseline. Source-grounded validation retains 94.0% of simulated training gains on real devices, versus 54.7% under self-validation. Learner guidance

translated_title: Trace2World：从真实交互轨迹重建应用世界以实现可扩展的GUI智能体训练
translated_abstract: 扩展GUI强化学习需要能够保留真实应用行为的环境。然而，将行为推断与编码相耦合，可能会把部分轨迹转变成状态转换错误的可运行模拟（mock）。我们提出Trace2World，它将全局行为重建与具体实现分离开来。该方法首先将多条轨迹调和为一个共享的、与来源关联的应用模型，然后编译出可执行的环境。通过独立回放来源工作流来定位不一致之处，从而进行有边界的实现修复。经过验证的世界进而可以在来源支持的行为范围内，支持面向学习者自适应的任务与环境增强。Trace2World从1,570条轨迹中构建了50个环境。在十个应用的200个工作流上，91.1%的工作流被端到端复现，而最强的任务局部匹配基线仅为59.8%。基于来源的验证在真实设备上保留了94.0%的模拟训练增益，而自我验证下仅为54.7%。学习者引导（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Trace2World通过将全局行为重建与环境实现分离，从真实交互轨迹构建忠实于真实应用行为的可执行GUI环境用于智能体训练，在十个应用的200个工作流上实现91.1%的端到端复现率，且基于来源的验证使真实设备上的训练增益保留率达94.0%。
en_tdlr: Trace2World separates global behavior reconstruction from implementation to compile executable GUI environments from real interaction traces, achieving 91.1% end-to-end workflow reproduction across ten apps and retaining 94.0% of simulated training gains on real devices via source-grounded validation.
